end.summary:
Multiplication by 10, 100 and 1000 using place value was shown, including why zeros are added.
Sameer practised doubling and halving: they first doubled both factors, then corrected this by halving one factor when doubling the other.
The misconception about doubling both numbers was corrected later in the lesson.
Estimation and rounding were practised; the rounding steps still need checking next time.
end.parentNote: Sameer practised place-value multiplication and used zero as a place-value change in several examples. They also corrected the doubling-and-halving mix-up by recognising that one factor must be doubled while the other is halved. Estimation was introduced, but rounding was not yet clear; at home, practise rounding numbers to the nearest ten using a number line.
